# Chaos Warrior Advancement Templates

*Pages PDF 8-9*

## **Chaos Warrior Advancement Templates**
## **Basic Chaos Warrior of Nurgle**
The basic Warrior of Nurgle uses the profile for a Chaos Warrior from page 334 of the **Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay Rulebook** with the addition of the _Disease (Itching Pox)_ and _Distracting_ optional Traits ( **WFRP** , page 339). The Mark of Nurgle (see page 10) is also applied. 

Their armour is a blend of heavy plate and mail, shields, and even unnatural defences such as fleshy growths or a horny hide. The weapons they carry are usually axes or swords, though certain Chaos Warriors may opt to specialise in double-handed weapons, flails, or polearms. 

## **Basic Chaos Warrior of Nurgle**
| M | WS | BS | S | T | I | Ag | Dex | Int | WP | Fel | W |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|4|55|30|45|55|45|55|30|35|55|25|19|

**Traits:** Animosity (Overt followers of Tzeentch), Armour 5, Champion, Corruption (Minor), Disease (Itching Pox), Distracting, Mark of Nurgle, Weapon +8 **Optional:** Mutation

## **Chaos Knight**
Chaos Knights are terrifying brutes who ride upon immensely powerful Chaos Steeds. They are merciless butchers capable of turning the course of a battle with their devastating charge. 

**CHAOS KNIGHT**

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
||+10||+5||+5|+10||||||

**Skills:** Athletics +10, Animal Care +10, Language (Battle) +10, Melee (Basic) +10, Melee (Cavalry) +10, Ride +20 

**Talents:** Rough Rider, Strike Mighty Blow

**Trappings:** Chaos Steed, Full Plate Armour, Lance, Hand Weapon, Shield

## **Forsaken**
There are those unfortunate Warriors of Chaos who fail to thrive on their path to glory, cursed with mutation and madness and made atavistic and frenzied. They set aside rational thought and rely on their jagged teeth and twisted claws for weapons. 

## Mounts
The dark stallions ridden by the Knights of Chaos are as fierce as their riders. They are coal-black chargers with daemonic ichor for blood, needle sharp teeth, and glimmers of cruel intelligence. They are often barded in sheets of fluted steel or corroded bronze. 

**CHAOS STEED**

## **Exalted Hero**
The infamy of Exalted Heroes is recorded in scattered chronicles, a catalogue of woes and evil deeds. They are dedicated to the brutal butchery of those who stand before them. 

## **Exalted Hero**
**M WS BS S T I Ag Dex Int WP Fel W** +25 +10 +15 +15 +25 +20 +10 +25 +10 

**Skills:** Cool +15, Dodge +15, Intimidate +15, Intuition +15, Language (Battle) +10, Leadership +15, Lore (Warfare) +10, Melee (any two) +20, Perception +10

**Talents:** Combat Aware, Combat Master, Combat Reflexes, Inspiring, Resolute, Warleader

**Trappings:** Full Plate Armour, Hand Weapon, Shield, Choice of appropriate Polearm or Two-Handed Weapon 

**Options:** An Exalted Hero may be equipped with a Chaos Steed, if so they have the extra Skill Ride +20

## Spell Lists
Chaos Sorcerers understand magic on an innate level. They lack the patience and wisdom of the Wizards of the Colleges, but their traditions are in many ways equivalent. Chaos Sorcerers use one of the following: the Lore of Fire, the Lore of Death, the Lore of Metal, or the Lore of Shadow. Chaos Sorcerers who bear the mark of a particular Chaos god may use spells from the Lore of Tzeentch, the Lore of Slaanesh, or the Lore of Nurgle respectively. 

## Chaos Sorcerers and Armour
Chaos Sorcerers suffer from the effects of wearing armour like other spellcasters. However, many of them are gifted with suits of Chaos Armour by their patron gods, and Chaos Armour does not inhibit spellcasting. When designing a Chaos Sorcerer character, decide whether it is wearing no armour, mundane armour (which inhibits spellcasting) or Chaos Armour (which does not). 

## **Chaos Sorcerer**
Chaos Sorcerers bargain with the dark gods for magical power. Whilst they lack the learning and discipline of wizards, they are nevertheless powerful spellcasters. 

## **Chaos Sorcerer**
**M WS BS S T I Ag Dex Int WP Fel W** +10 +15 +10 +20 +20 +10 

**Skills:** Channelling +5, Cool +15, Dodge +10, Entertain (Storytelling) +10, Intuition +15, Language (Magick) +10, Lore (Magic) +10, Melee (Basic or Polearm) +10, Perception +20 

**Talents:** Arcane Magic, Petty Magic, Second Sight

**Trappings:** Hand Weapon, Staff, Robes or Armour, Magic Item.

**Spells:** Choose 3 spells from the Petty Magic list and up to 6 from the Arcane Magic list. 

**Options:** A Chaos Sorcerer may be equipped with a Chaos Steed, if so they have the extra Skill Ride +20 

## **Chaos Sorcerer Lord**
Most Chaos Sorcerers are doomed to short careers, descending into mutation and madness in service of the Chaos Gods. Those who persevere may become masters of forbidden arcane arts.
